approved_source_object.title: The cyclic affine type A Cartan datum and its residues
approved_source_object.statement: Fix e≥2, I=Z/eZ and A with a_ii=2, a_(i,i±1)=−1 for e≥3 and the single double-edge a_01=a_10=−2 for e=2; all d_i=1 and q_i=q. Choose the explicit free lattices P=⊕_i Z Lambda_i⊕Z delta and Pvee=⊕_i Z h_i⊕Z d, with <Lambda_j,h_i>=delta_ij, <delta,h_i>=0, <Lambda_j,d>=0, <delta,d>=1. Define alpha_i=Σ_j a_ji Lambda_j+delta_(i,0) delta. Then the simple roots are independent, Σ_i alpha_i=delta, <h_i,alpha_j>=a_ij, and <d,alpha_i>=delta_(i,0). The central c=Σ_i h_i has <c,alpha_i>=0. Level means <c,weight>; Lambda_i has level1. The symmetric root form has (alpha_i,alpha_j)=a_ij; this is distinct from the lattice pairing. Put P_cl=P/Z delta. The diagram reflection tau fixes Lambda0,delta,d and sends Lambda_i,alpha_i,h_i to the indices−i. The finite vector representation below has level0; its perfect crystal has level1.
approved_source_object.strategy: The Cartan identities follow from the displayed cycle/double edge. For roots, A has kernel Q·(1,…,1): Σ a_ij x_j=0 implies x constant by the finite sum Σ(x_i−x_(i+1))² (for e=2 use its displayed matrix). A linear relation Σ x_i alpha_i=0 therefore has constant x, and its delta coefficient x0=0 forces all x=0. The chosen pairing is perfect on the explicit bases and the roots/coroots define a valid minimal affine datum of rank e+1. Row sums give delta and c identities. Reflection of the cycle fixes the0 coordinate, so tau preserves all pairings/roots and extends to the full datum. No fundamental weights are silently assumed for an unrelated datum.
